good: The project makes anything people look at: web pages, app screens, dashboards, HTML reports.
costs: Each visual change is screenshotted and reviewed, which adds a few minutes per change.
does: Takes screenshots of anything visual it builds, looks at them and fixes what looks wrong.
outcome: Pages and screens that look right on phone and desktop, in light and dark mode.
title: Visual interface
for: Projects with anything people look at: app screens, web pages, dashboards, desktop windows, HTML reports or pages produced as deliverables.
notFor: Projects with no screens or HTML output. If one appears later, the gui-pack check asks for this pack.
menu: | U1 | Check the GUI | gui.md | screenshot every screen I changed (desktop + phone, light + dark), review them, fix what's wrong, and repeat until a round finds nothing |
precedence: Only the look changes → `gui.md`. A screen changes as part of a feature or fix → that runbook, plus the review loop from `gui.md`.
layout: Screenshots for the GUI review loop
